observations: Photo 0 shows a pile of used car engines and engine components in a cluttered outdoor or semi-outdoor setting.
One engine has a visible silver valve cover with 'HONDA' embossed on it.
Another engine has a black plastic cover with a ribbed grille design.
The engines appear dirty, with oil residue and grime, and some parts are missing or damaged.
A person's legs are visible on the right edge of the photo, suggesting the photo was taken in a workshop or scrapyard.
No visible branding or model numbers on the engines themselves.
The seller's text mentions 'all kinds of car spare parts' and 'Tokunbo, direct from Belgium. Tested and working, no knock, low mileage, never opened.'

claims.claim: We also deals on all kinds of car spare parts
claims.evidence: Seller's text only; no photo shows this clearly enough to read.

claims.claim: Tokunbo, direct from Belgium. Tested and working, no knock, low mileage, never opened.
claims.evidence: No photo shows this; it is the seller's word only.

risks.risk: Engines may be damaged, non-functional, or have hidden mechanical issues (e.g., internal wear, cracked block, seized components).
risks.proof: Close-up photos of the engine block, cylinder head, and internal components (e.g., crankshaft, pistons, oil pan) to verify condition.
risks.if_unproven: Priced as not working or severely damaged.

risks.risk: Engine may be from a non-Honda vehicle or not compatible with buyer's vehicle.
risks.proof: Photo of the engine's VIN tag or casting number, or a photo showing the engine installed in a vehicle.
risks.if_unproven: Priced as generic used engine, not Honda-specific.

risks.risk: Engine may have been salvaged from a wrecked or accident-damaged vehicle.
risks.proof: Photo of the vehicle's VIN plate or documentation showing the source vehicle's condition.
risks.if_unproven: Priced as unknown source, lower value.

proof_requests: Close-up of the engine or gearbox code: the plate, sticker or number stamped on the block or case.
Photo of the engine's VIN tag or casting number.
Close-up photos of the engine block, cylinder head, and internal components.
Photo of the engine installed in a vehicle or documentation of its source.
response.reason: What the item is shows, but not the model that sets its price: no photo shows it clearly enough to read. The shot asked for first would settle it.
